name: Office Building HVAC Energy Optimisation
description: An AI controller that adjusts air-conditioning set-points in company office buildings based on occupancy counts, weather forecast and electricity tariffs to reduce energy use, within safe limits set by facilities engineers.
documentation:
DATA: temperature, humidity, anonymous occupancy counts from door sensors (no cameras, no badge identities), weather and tariff data.
SAFETY LIMITS: set-points bounded between 22 and 26 C by hard-coded rules the model cannot override.
OVERSIGHT: facilities engineers can override any zone from the BMS; automatic fallback to the standard schedule if the model fails.
RESULTS: 6-month pilot on one building saved 14% energy with no increase in comfort complaints.
SECURITY: runs on the isolated building-management network; vendor access via approved remote-access process.
MONITORING: weekly energy and comfort report; all set-point changes logged.
